label: Run Music Base (Android: Pixel 8)
command: flutter emulators --launch Pixel_8 && while true; do device_id="$(flutter devices --machine 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import json, sys; devices = json.load(sys.stdin); print(next((device["id"] for device in devices if device.get("targetPlatform", "").startswith("android")), ""))')"; [ -n "$device_id" ] && break; sleep 2; done; flutter run -d "$device_id"

label: Run Music Base (Android: physical device)
command: while true; do device_id="$(flutter devices --machine 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import json, sys; devices = json.load(sys.stdin); print(next((device["id"] for device in devices if device.get("targetPlatform", "").startswith("android") and not device.get("emulator", False)), ""))')"; [ -n "$device_id" ] && break; sleep 2; done; flutter run -d "$device_id"
